translations.web: You shall be holy to me, for I, Yahweh, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.
translations.bsb: You are to be holy to Me because I, the LORD, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be My own.
translations.kjv: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people,
translations.asv: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I, Jehovah, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that ye should be mine.
